prompts.text: Inspect the state of the currently running moonshot loop -- share # of turns, tokens used so far, and summarize changes / issues
How are jobs running from moonshot loop? Is it using the verification run process where jobs are run and verified or something else? Any reason why or why not that you can infer?

Have any commits been made so far? I would prefer moonshots fit into one session whenever possible, as it's difficult to say when to stop them with acceptance criteria, as with other jobs. If you hav…
I like chaining the sessions because future sessions learn implicitly from previous sessions -- this is by design. I think auto compaction is probably the way to go. If we hit auto compact without a…

Make a note for conductor brief -- we will likely want a moonshot conductor, that makes some qualitative judgment on compact (i.e., whether it's compacting because the work is really hard but still m…
Summarize the moonshot prove loop status for me here -- what progress has it made towards proving the example, what hl capabilities have been added, etc.
The prove moonshot loop just completed stage 2, summarize changes here as per above
Summarize current state of moonshot prove loop and what it's waiting for

Let's plan to stop the withdrawn job. Send a note to the verification loop agent summarizing this to avoid confusion, then hopefully that is considered when the prove loop picks up job results and we…
Start a new tmux window called skill
Summarize what the prove moonshot loop has done since your last check
Summarize progress of moonshot prove loop (since last update) and tmux window 7 (skill refactoring)
Create a new tmux window called 'landing'
Create a new tmux window called codex
Summarize the current state / recent progress of the prove-examples moonshot loop.
The moonshot workspace may have some changes designed to address this, and is likely simpler / more effective to apply than conductor. Can you confirm or deny this?
How about a minor change to uzporttn enabling compact at 600k by default and do not stop the loop? We can monitor from here for now, effectively acting as the conductor, though we definitely want to…
Let's do #2, but monitor here -- if it stops, implement #1 and restart in the same tmux window (should start from the stopped cycle). Feel free to send the skill session a note about this amendment,…
Summarize the current state of the prove moonshot loop
Do we need two monitors? It looks like both are running, stop one of them and have it run for 5h (to potentially catch future examples stopping too, as I may be away)
What is the status of the moonshot prove loop session?
